text:
Alex: Morning rec — anyone got low-key albums or short films for a rainy walk playlist?
Maya: Yes! Been looping some city pop lately. Anri and Mariya Takeuchi are perfect for a soft morning mood. :sun_with_face: 
CJ: Instrumental recs are my fallback for walks. Nujabes, Emancipator, and old Bonobo tracks. Keeps the tempo chill. :headphones: 
Sofia: Also want a short, cozy book rec — nothing heavy.
Alex: 'The Little Paris Bookshop' is an easy, warm read. 250 pages, done on a commute.
Maya: If you want something weird but short, try 'The Egg' by Andy Weir (flash fiction) or anything from Kelly Link's short stories.
CJ: Quick playlist dump (feel free to steal):
```
- Nujabes — Feather
- Emancipator — Safe In The Steep Cliffs
- Khruangbin — White Gloves
- Khruangbin — Maria También
- Sevdaliza — Human
- Radiohead — Morning Bell (instrumental-ish mood)
```
Maya: For films: short/indie rec — 'World of Tomorrow' (animated, 17m) and 'The Fall' for visuals if you want something longer but not mainstream.
Sofia: Poll idea: what should the coffee break feature today? 1) New album swap 2) Short film screening 3) Book swap (bring a paperback)
CJ: vote: 3
Maya: vote: 2
Alex: vote: 1
OpsBot: Reminder: Coffee room reserved 11:30-12:00 today. Please don't leave food unattended. :coffee:
Sofia: I'll bring a small stack of paperbacks from my shelf if anyone wants to trade.
Maya: I'll bring pastries! :yum:
Alex: I'll queue the playlist in the breakroom speaker and bring chamomile tea.
CJ: Dropping a Spotify link for the walk mix: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder — will update with the tracks above.
Maya: Love it, see y'all there. Also tagging @Sofia for the book swap reminder.
Sofia: got it, thanks!
Alex: Tiny victory shoutout: finally finished my rooftop run loop without getting lost. small wins. :raised_hands:
